post.originalText:
Opus 5.5 is crazy at designing apps. Here’s my full process on how i make iOS apps right now:

- Create a moodboard of designs you like (Doesn't have to be same niche
- GPT 5 for creating a 1st draft mockup, Ask it to generate a proper ios styled app with no realistic visuals
- Add all best claude skills and mobbin MCP
- Feed image to Claude and ask it to build 1:1 
- Use higgsfield MCP for video generation wherever needed 
- Iterate till perfection
